sources.title: Census: substantial county changes in the 2020s

states.basis: Actual county FIPS inventories in both years match the full Census 2024 roster. Each year’s real district portions are aggregated independently; no district votes are allocated to counties. The substantial county-change list was checked; minor cartographic corrections were not individually adjudicated. District boundaries, candidates and contestation can change, so a countywide difference does not determine a cause.
limitations: This is a complete countywide aggregate, not a matched same-seat or same-candidate comparison.
All current counts are provisional; complete source scope does not establish counting completion or certification.
